rv.q: This “Purple Rain,” alas, does not comprehend the power of something we’ll never understand.

Adapted from Prince's 1984 film by Tony- and Pulitzer-winner Branden Jacobs-Jenkins and staged as a boisterous concert-cum-behind-the-music drama by Lileana Blain-Cruz, 'Rain' faces dramaturgical challenges that it must address if it's to make it on Broadway.
The opening night performance was shot through with thrilling entertainment.

sg.ra: Choose Center Orchestra rows B-H for close, head-on views without side angles or the mezzanine overhang.
Choose Rows A or B for some of the theater’s best views and a panoramic look at the stage. Expect premium pricing in these front rows. Row A also has a little extra legroom.
The side Orchestra offers a decent view for a reasonable price.

sn.c: The Front Mezzanine overhangs at row H, potentially cutting off action at the top of the stage.
sn.sh: Front Mezzanine overhangs at row H

sn.c: The sides of the Orchestra offer a decent view for a reasonable price, although parts of the stage become more obstructed towards the outside.
sn.sh: Decent Orchestra side views for a reasonable price

sn.c: Center seats in rows C to G in the Front Mezzanine are value for money considering the clean view and ticket prices.
sn.sh: Clean views and value in Front Mezzanine rows C to G

sn.lo: Center Rear Mezzanine, rows A to B
sn.c: Rows A and B towards the center of the Rear Mezzanine offer direct, largely uninhibited sightlines down to the stage.
sn.sh: Very good value with direct sightlines

sn.c: Row K in the Left and Right Orchestra has an aisle in front of it, giving extra legroom.
The Rear Mezzanine is furthest from the stage and may not be best for specific details.

vs.sum: The Majestic Theatre is one of Broadway's most storied houses, but its 1,645-seat scale means rear and side sections have meaningful sightline limitations and obstructed views. Legroom is tight and restrooms insufficient for the volume, though the historic ambiance is genuine.

acc.note: 4 wheelchair locations in Orchestra. No steps to rows AA-H. Infrared devices available.
